settings.title: Taxonomy
settings.subtitle: Organise subscriptions with categories and tags shared across your workspace.

picker.helper: Categories come from Master data → Categories. Type to search, or add a new one if you manage categories.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Two levels: a category and optional subcategories. Default categories can be renamed or archived but keep their matching rules.
categories.budgetHint: Optional. Used for budget alerts and category spend reports.
categories.archiveConfirmBody: Subcategories are archived too. Subscriptions keep their category but it will no longer be offered when editing.
categories.empty: No categories yet. Add one to get started.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free-form labels for cross-cutting themes such as projects, cost centres or review status.
tags.noTags: No tags yet. Tags are created while editing subscriptions or here.
tags.mergeDescription: Subscriptions tagged with the selected tags will be re-tagged with the target. The selected tags are then deleted.
tags.deleteConfirmBody: It is removed from {count, plural, =0 {no subscriptions} =1 {1 subscription} other {# subscriptions}}. This cannot be undone.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.description: Extra attributes captured on every subscription, such as contract owner or internal reference.
customFields.limitReached: You have reached the limit of {max} custom fields. Archive one to add another.
customFields.keyHint: Stable identifier used in exports and the API. Generated from the label if left blank.
customFields.archivedHint: Archived fields keep their values but are no longer shown on forms.

errors.invalidOption: Choose one of the listed options

cancellation.title: How to cancel
cancellation.noticePeriod: Give at least {days, plural, =1 {1 day} other {# days}} notice before the renewal date.
cancellation.noGuide: No cancellation guide is available for this service yet.
